name: 음소-비짐 매핑 분석
description: Validates phoneme-to-viseme correspondence — deepfakes often fail to correctly map audio phonemes to lip shapes.
mechanism:
이 방법은 creates and analyzes phoneme-to-viseme mapping 딥페이크 탐지를 위해:

1. **포괄적Viseme매핑**: A many-to-one mapping from phonemes to visemes is established and verified per video. Multiple phonemes map to the same viseme (e.g., /p/, /b/, /m/ all produce bilabial closure). 본 방법은 checks that phonemes with the same target viseme actually produce the same visual appearance.

2. **VisemeCluster분석**: For each viseme category, all instances across the video are collected and analyzed for consistency. The visual appearance of the same viseme should be 일관된 throughout the video. High intra-viseme variance suggests AI generation where the lip model doesn't consistently reproduce the same visual targets.

3. **Speaker-SpecificVisemeModel**: Each speaker has characteristic viseme shapes determined by their dental/skeletal structure and speaking habits. 본 방법은 builds a per-speaker viseme model and checks temporal consistency. 딥페이크는 보일 수 있다 일관성 없는 viseme shapes as the generator doesn't maintain a stable articulatory model.

4. **TransitionTrajectory분석**: Viseme-to-viseme transitions follow curved trajectories through the lip configuration space, determined by articulatory dynamics. 본 방법은 analyzes transition trajectories for physical plausibility — AI 생성 transitions may take shorter (unnatural shortcuts) or longer (meandering) paths than anatomically possible.

5. **VisemeDuration분포**: Each viseme has a characteristic duration distribution dependent on the phonemic context and speaking rate. 본 방법은 checks whether viseme durations follow expected distributions. AI lip generation may produce visemes with incorrect or implausibly uniform durations.
parameters: 분석 유형: 자동 통계\n점수 범위: 0(실제)~100(AI 생성)
source: 디지털 포렌식 및 AI 콘텐츠 탐지 관련 동료 검토 연구 기반.
useCase: AI 생성 콘텐츠를 탐지하기 위한 다중 신호 분석 파이프라인의 일부로 사용.
strengths: • 연구 기반 방법론\n• 빠른 계산 속도\n• 다른 탐지 방법과 보완적
limitations: • 정확도는 입력 품질에 따라 변동\n• 다른 방법과 함께 사용하는 것이 최적

references.title: Agarwal, S. et al. (2020). Detecting Deep-Fake Videos from Phoneme-Viseme Mismatches. CVPR Workshop.
Haliassos, A. et al. (2021). Lips Don't Lie: A Generalisable and Robust Approach to Face Forgery Detection. CVPR.
